title: Roman Empire
capsule: The Roman Empire was the post-Republican Mediterranean superstate founded by Augustus in 27 BC after the end of the Roman Republic. At its height it encompassed the entire Mediterranean basin, Western Europe, the Balkans, Anatolia, the Levant, and North Africa, governed from Rome. It endured repeated crises and was periodically divided administratively before the definitive partition of 395 AD.
